retained_boundaries: Assumption-dependent constructions are permitted; unidentified guarantees are not.
Numeric evidence-use choices can affect the generated law, but declaration validation cannot establish that use or a causal benefit.
Schema validity, source agreement and verified execution do not certify target scientific validity.
Source-semantic review must be independent of merely copying the requested recipe.
No superiority claim, extra agent, baseline, new cohort or additional execution is required.
